body:
Add a nonproving ledger-9 SDK consumer for a produced Sherlock A102 Literal transition. It checks the emitted ZKIR through `ProofPreimage::check`, preserves the two 2077-element public transcripts and empty raw inputs, and can export the exact program bytes, statement and transition for comparison with the frozen independent oracle. The selected positive test also checks four corrupted transitions.

Validation: exact two-file candidate received independent Gemini 4 Argon high source approval during the observed Opus outage; source hashes and patch whitespace verified. Native compilation and SDK test execution are pending the corrected cached-build prerequisite. This draft is not a proof, deployment or requirement-closure claim. Local CI only.
